# PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt

PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt is a psychiatric department in Region Midtjylland that appears in the 2024 ADHD database annual report as one of the country's higher-performing facilities on several treatment-quality indicators for adult ADHD patients [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

The clinic is highlighted in the report's discussion of Indicator 8, which measures the share of treatment courses in which patients begin ADHD-related psychoeducation within 120 days of starting treatment — a measure introduced for the first time for adult patients (18+) in the 2024 report [^src1]. Nationally this indicator reached only 36 % against a development goal of 90 %, with significant regional variation and registration problems, particularly in Region Nordjylland and Region Hovedstaden [^src1]. Against that backdrop, PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt stood out: it was one of only three departments nationwide to reach or exceed 80 % fulfillment of the psychoeducation indicator, alongside [[psy-lokalpsykiatri-toender|PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder)]] (83 %) and [[pho-klinik-1-horsens|PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens]] (82 %) [^src1].

The clinic also appears in the report's figures on a related indicator, where it is recorded with a denominator/numerator ratio of "4 / 5" corresponding to 80 % (with a confidence interval of 28–99) [^src2], and elsewhere with "5 / 5" corresponding to 100 % (confidence interval 48–100) [^src3]. In the broader discussion of Indicator 11 — which measures whether adult patients are in ADHD medication treatment within 120 days of starting a package course, reported for the first time for adults in 2024 — the report notes that results across departments with more than three patients ranged from a low of 21 % at [[pck-psykoterapeutisk-klinik|PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik]] in Hovedstaden to a high of 100 % at several facilities, including [[ps-almenpsykiatrisk-syd-ambulatorier|PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier]] in Nordjylland, PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt in Midtjylland, and [[aabenraa-boerne-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa)]] [^src3]. That contrast — from 21 % to 100 % — is presented in the report as evidence of large regional and departmental variation, which the steering group attributes at least partly to differences in registration practice rather than purely to clinical performance (a broader theme discussed for Region Nordjylland at 85 % versus Region Hovedstaden at 37 % on Indicator 11) [^src3].

Taken together, the mentions position PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt as a consistently strong performer among Danish psychiatric departments on ADHD treatment-quality indicators reported for adults in 2024, reaching 80 % on the psychoeducation indicator and figures of 80–100 % on related measures, placing it among the top-performing facilities nationally [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

- **facility-performance** (Page 57): Blandt afdelinger med mere end tre patienter fra 21 % på PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik i Hovedstaden til 100 % på PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier i Nordjylland, PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt i Midtjylland og PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) [^src1]
